steps: Attach the X axis to the same logical machine as the A axis
Verify the X and A axes are assigned to the same logical machine
Check the Joint logical machine parameter for both axes to ensure they are set to the same logical machine number
If the axes are already on the same logical machine, reinitialise the CNC system
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the axis's current logical machine assignment
Use the attach command to assign the x' axis to logical machine 1
Verify the axis is now attached to logical machine 1
Check the part program search hierarchy for 'm101.pp' in the configured paths.
Verify the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4 (trailing subprogram call).
Add at least 3 control points between `splineon` and `splineoff` commands.
Verify the spline type is properly defined in the `splineon` block.
If the spline type is uniform or chord-length, ensure control points are evenly spaced.
If the spline type is B-spline, ensure no duplicate control points are used.
Verify the initial feedrate is specified in the `splineon` block if needed.
Edit the program to remove all class 1 preparatory words except one per block.
Check the joint logical device settings to ensure logical device 5 is assigned to only one joint.
Verify the logical device number 5 is uniquely mapped in the Joint logical device parameter.
If the logical device 5 is already correctly mapped, reinitialise the configuration.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license status to confirm the OPC UA server option is not included.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if it is required.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
If the device is in SAFEOP but expected to be OP, restart the drive
If the Master state changed, ensure it is set to OP
If the error code is zero, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
Verify the error code and error register values
If the error is informational, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system to recover from the error
Check the Ethercat master log file for detailed error information
If multiple errors occur, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Upload firmware for device Drive_3 using the correct file path
Verify the firmware version is now 1.4.0 by checking the device's reported error register
Restart the fieldbus to ensure the new firmware is active
If the firmware version is still incorrect, check the firmware file path and ensure it is accessible
If the fieldbus is in an incorrect state, use AMCore.exe -start device to transition it to PREOP
If the firmware version is not updating, power cycle the device or reinitialise the fieldbus
